$comment: #EXP-2109 (owner 2026-11-25), #EXP-2168 (owner 2026-11-26: ONE header concept on EVERY page, detail pages included) THE HEADER: ONE rule for every page's header ×5 (iOS, Android, web-mobile, web md+, the desktop IDE), top-level and detail alike (issue, chat/session, agent, app, device, call view, settings subpages, repo, CI run, the find bar replacing a chat's header). LEFT: the back control (a pushed page) or the close control (a bar that replaces the header) = THE ROUND ICON BUTTON too (`leading`: concept per control), then the leading glyph, the title, LEFT-aligned, never centred. RIGHT: `order`, headerActions(page): status (what the page reports: the waiting chips, the issue graph), primary (the page's ONE labelled verb: Create, Publish, Start, the Merge pill; the only text a header holds), call, page (the page's own icon: the inbox's mark read, a device's settings, the find bar's previous / next), search, inbox, add, more; a page lists only what it has (`pages`, phone and wide; null = the page has no header there). Every control but status and primary is THE ROUND ICON BUTTON, one look everywhere: `circle` px on phones (the filled circle: web `HeaderAction`, Android `PageHeaderCircle`, iOS `HeaderCircleButton`), `wideCircle` px on web md+ and the IDE (the same filled circle, desktop `header_button`); the glyph `glyph` / `wideGlyph`; never a ghost glyph, never a hand-rolled circle. ADD = concept `icons.add`, always its OWN button, never an entry of the `…`; it runs the page's one create verb at once (`adds`), or opens the create menu where there are several. MORE = concept `icons.more`, always LAST, only secondary verbs: headerMenu(entries) = the page's menu without `menuDrops` (what the + does, Open on the page itself, Move to folder: the tree's), separators tidied; an empty one = no button. ROWS that carry the pair (a team's row in the tree, `rows`) wear the same + then …. A row's long-press / right-click keeps its WHOLE menu (sidebar-menus.json). A settings list's own New pill in its section band is not a header. GUARD (`guard`, replayed by apps/web `header-guard.test.ts` over every client's sources on every PR): per client the shared round control (`round`) and the header hosts (`hosts`); no host's call may hold a `banned` control, and the `gone` names (the old ghost / hand-rolled header buttons) exist nowhere.
